summary: Prevent governance imports from creating bytecode in managed worktrees

delivery.outcome: Make managed governance validation read-only when dynamically importing trusted checks, so scheduled and PR checks do not create bytecode in adopter worktrees.
nonGoals: Do not weaken scope, lease or required-check validation
Do not mutate other tickets or adopter repositories
Do not treat local validation as independent protected approval

architecture.decision: Suppress Python bytecode only while importing managed validators and restore the previous interpreter policy in finally. Keep the packaged checker synchronized and exercise scheduled workflows with real installed runtime.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the checker and test changes.

validation.evidence: Installed isolated runtime executes both scheduled workflows without bytecode or scope failures.
Governance, package and range checks stay enforced; protected OneDev and independent Validator still required.
